in_hebrew.name: Austreng
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Austreng הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'eostre', meaning east. Austreng can be interpreted as 'strong one from the east'. In Christian context, it can also be associated with the resurrection of Christ as the sun rises after the dark night.
